profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Embedded Medical Devices
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer working in the medical device industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in GUI Development and prototyping, Code Review, Embedded Software, Unit Testing, Medical Devices, and Mechanical Ventilation. Certified Scrum Master who applies Agile methodologies to lead SW teams in sprint planning using Agile tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps), DSUs, retrospectives, backlog grooming, and demos to complete features and meet team deliverables. Acted as a SW manager and responsible for allocating resources, planning for future projects, and providing schedule estimates to leadership, product owners, and project management.
